lcpDiagnostic.method: Two serial cold navigations per surface after the official E2E log ended. Same Chromium, viewport, reduced motion, no throttling, fresh context, cache disabled. Node control serves production-build static file bytes; HTML and dynamic routes proxy the same Wrangler SSR on port 4173. Node assets are uncompressed; Wrangler compresses text/CSS/JS/SVG, so encodedBodySize differs while decoded SHA-256 matches. No app/build changes.

wranglerSerial.cache: disabled; fresh context for each navigation

lcpDiagnostic.conclusion: The 9.4 s / 6.0 s measurements are local preview diagnostics with contention. Without E2E, Wrangler still exhibits seconds of asset queue/response delivery; the exact-build static control paints the same mobile LCP assets in 184–352 ms. This is direct evidence that local asset serving/queueing dominates these slow samples. It does not establish a hosted/field CWV pass or promise equivalent CDN/network performance.

finalHomeCaptures.method: Production Wrangler 4173; fresh sequential contexts; optional consent rejected; all nine cards exposed vertically and horizontally before reset to page top.
